zotero.abstractNote: Background: Large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT have shown potential in medical examinations. This study evaluates the performance of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 on the German board examination for ophthalmology. Methods: We used 100 multiple-choice questions from the German board examination for ophthalmology. ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 were tested on these questions. Results: ChatGPT-4 achieved a significantly higher score than ChatGPT-3.5. Both models showed limitations in clinical reasoning and image-based questions. Conclusion: While ChatGPT-4 demonstrates promising performance, it is not yet a substitute for human expertise in ophthalmology board examinations.
